_about: The shared list of farm operation types used by the Knowledge Base, AgTrail and the monitoring hub, and the mapping of every Knowledge Base operation_id onto it. The mapping is by operation_id and is the same for every crop unless crop_overrides says otherwise. review_status 'proposed' means a clear mapping waiting for approval and 'needs-decision' means an agronomist must choose. Nothing here is approved yet, so the whole file is UNVERIFIED. satellite_evidence is informational and comes from the integration plan; it is also UNVERIFIED.

categories.description: Putting seed or seedlings in the field.
Anything else, such as irrigation, pruning or thinning.

cover_crop_establishment.name: Legume Cover Crop Establishment
cover_crop_establishment.reason: Sowing a cover crop is not planting the main crop.

curing.name: Curing (Field Curing)
curing.reason: Curing onions or sweet potatoes is a drying step.

drying_threshing.name: Drying & Threshing
drying_threshing.reason: Drying plus threshing. Threshing could be processing.

field_draining.name: Field Draining
field_draining.reason: Draining a flooded field. No matching category.

fire_trace_maintenance.name: Fire-Trace Maintenance
fire_trace_maintenance.reason: Firebreaks round a tree crop. No matching category.

gap_filling.name: Gap Filling / Replanting
gap_filling.reason: Replanting missing stands. Partly a planting, but it only changes part of the field.

girth_monitoring.name: Girth Monitoring
girth_monitoring.reason: Measuring trees, a check not an operation.

irrigation.name: Irrigation
irrigation.reason: The shared list puts irrigation under other.

isolation_verification.name: Isolation Distance Verification
isolation_verification.reason: A check, not a field operation.

land_clearing.name: Land Clearing
land_clearing.reason: Clearing the plot is land preparation.

mulching.name: Mulching
mulching.reason: Covering the soil. No matching category.

nursery_establishment.name: Nursery Establishment
nursery_establishment.reason: A nursery is not the field planting. A planting signal expects green-up in the field 2 to 4 weeks later, which a nursery would not cause. CEO decision: counts as planting (was proposed as other).

pest_scouting.name: Pest & Disease Scouting/Control
pest_scouting.reason: Looking for pests, not controlling them. Satellite would show no change.

planting_material_sourcing.name: Planting Material Sourcing
planting_material_sourcing.reason: Buying or collecting material, not a field operation.

post_harvest_handling.name: Post-Harvest Handling
post_harvest_handling.reason: A general handling step. Sorting is the closest category.

pruning.name: Pruning
pruning.reason: The shared list puts pruning under other.

reridging.name: Re-ridging / Hilling
reridging.reason: Earthing up ridges, often done with weeding. No matching category.

seed_selection.name: Seed/Variety Selection
seed_selection.reason: Preparation with no visible change on the farm.

seed_selection_treatment.name: Seed Selection & Treatment
seed_selection_treatment.reason: Preparation with no visible change on the farm.

seed_yam_selection.name: Seed Yam Selection & Treatment
seed_yam_selection.reason: Preparation with no visible change on the farm.

shade_management.name: Shade Management
shade_management.reason: Managing shade trees. No matching category.

shade_tree_establishment.name: Shade Tree Establishment
shade_tree_establishment.reason: Perennial shade trees, not the main crop. CEO decision: counts as planting (was proposed as other).

splitting.name: Washing & Splitting
splitting.reason: Splitting ginger or cashew is processing.

stimulation.name: Ethephon Stimulation
stimulation.reason: Rubber latex stimulation is a chemical on the tree, not a fertilizer.

tapping.name: Tapping
tapping.reason: Rubber latex is harvested by tapping many times. Satellite evidence would not apply to a tree crop.

thinning.name: Thinning
thinning.reason: The shared list puts thinning under other.

transplanting.name: Transplanting
transplanting.reason: Moving seedlings to the field is the field planting.

vine_sourcing.name: Vine Cutting Sourcing / Selection
vine_sourcing.reason: Buying or collecting material, not a field operation.

water_management.name: Water Management (Flooding)
water_management.reason: Water control. Probably irrigation-like, but the name is broad.

approval.approved_by: CEO, acting as agronomist, via the Farm Jobs Check page (answers received 2026-10-23)
approval.approved: 52 of 54 operations: the 30 proposed as clear, and 22 of the 24 that needed a decision (20 as suggested, 2 changed).
decisions: Changed from the suggestion: nursery_establishment and shade_tree_establishment count as planting.

Tree crops (rubber, cocoa, oil palm): the satellite is used as evidence. Harvesting must not cause a drop in greenness. A sharp drop on one farm is flagged as possible fire, clearing or disease. Not yet asked: comparing with nearby farms, and asking for a delivery weight or photo as proof of harvest.
Not yet asked: the two proposed new groups (seed and planting material; looking after the crop).
